Let \(t=\cos2x\). Then \(\cos x(\cos x-\cos5x)=(1-t^2)(2t+1)\). For \(t<-\tfrac12\), the sides have incompatible signs. For \(t>-\tfrac12\), division gives \(t^2-2t+\tfrac34=0\), hence \(t=\tfrac12\). Also \(t=-\tfrac12\) works. Thus
\[
\boxed{x=\frac{k\pi}{2}\pm\frac{\pi}{6},\quad k\in\mathbb Z.}
\]
